countries.name: Algeria

age_bands.label: Under 15 or over 50
age_bands.detail: Visa-exempt for up to 90 days within any 180-day period.

age_bands.label: Ages 15–18 and 35–50
age_bands.detail: 30-day single-entry e-Visa if holding valid Schengen / USA / UK / Ireland visa or residence and meeting conditions.

countries.stay_rule: Algerian ordinary passport rules depend on age: under 15 and over 50 are visa-exempt (90/180). Ages 15–18 and 35–50 may get a 30-day single-entry e-Visa with Schengen/USA/UK/Ireland visa or residence.

countries.name: Libya

age_bands.label: Under 16 or over 45

countries.name: Egypt

age_bands.label: Under 15 or over 45
age_bands.detail: Can obtain e-Visa without Schengen/USA/UK/Ireland precondition.

age_bands.label: Ages 15–45
age_bands.detail: 30-day single-entry e-Visa if holding valid Schengen / USA / UK / Ireland visa or residence AND flying with Turkish Airlines, AJet, Pegasus, EgyptAir or Air Cairo.

countries.stay_rule: Egyptian ordinary passport holders need a visa. Under 15 and over 45 can get e-Visa without precondition. Ages 15–45 need Schengen/USA/UK/Ireland visa or residence and must travel with THY, AJet, Pegasus, EgyptAir or Air Cairo for 30-day single-entry e-Visa.
countries.ai_extra_context: Egypt 15–45 also requires airline condition: Turkish Airlines, AJet, Pegasus, EgyptAir or Air Cairo. Reference UX: https://evisacity.com/egypt
